decisions.rationale: Salt shed, 7 x 14 m, tarred plank walls with two doors, a 52 degree shingle roof with a ridge vent to 8.9 m; 352 triangles, 31,060 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: No salt heaps, sacks or pans outside; the shed relies on placement for context.
Tarred walls are near-black; under the overcast grade the detail only reads within about 25 m.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Saltmarket and Wreckers' Rest (Salt Coast) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
